title: Credo (Josquin, Missa Mater patris)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Missa Mater patris, Credo. 4 voices (Altus 1, Altus 2, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos1001c); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
